title: Treaty of Marienburg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Marienburg", at revision 1380017924, opens: "The treaty of Marienburg, concluded on 25 June 1656 N.S., was an alliance between Brandenburg-Prussia and the Swedish Empire during the Second Northern War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1449567, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1656 treaty between Sweden and Brandenburg". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
